messages:
eli.design: small design review — focusing on CTA clarity for canary increases, rollback label wording, and a timeline search affordance. mock: https://figma.redwood/rollout-cta-ux
zoe_pm: TL;DR: prefer CTA that states the action + percent + variant. needs audit link in toast and a clear rollback button after change. :spiral_note_pad:
harry.eng: implementation: we can add a 'View audit' id in response and surface it in toast. rollback button can trigger a 0% allocation action with a quick confirm. also can block API requests above typed threshold (>=60%).
marie_a11y: accessibility points: 1) CTA should be explicit like "Increase to 40% — v3-beta" for SR clarity. 2) Make rollback button distinct (color + aria-describedby explaining effect). 3) timeline search needs autocomplete suggestions and live region when results update.
olga_research: in testing participants wanted an inline 'Why did this change?' link in the modal that opens the audit panel. timeline search was useful for finding versions by tag or deployer. default expanded timeline up to 10 versions, then collapse older ones into "Archived history" with a count.
eli.design: microcopy proposal for modal header: "Confirm allocation change" body: "You are about to route 40% of production traffic to variant 'v3-beta'. This change is immediate. Type 'v3-beta' to confirm." footer: checklist + reason field. Is "immediate" too scary?
zoe_pm: keep 'immediate' but add: "Notifications will be sent to #deployments and on-call." require selecting 'Monitoring checked' checkbox before confirm.
harry.eng: we'll emit notifications and include audit_id. typed-confirm for >=50% only. API will reject non-typed calls above that.
marie_a11y: button label must include percent and variant. Confirm button should be first tabbable element after cancel? prefer focus trap that moves to cancel first for safety. aria-live: "Allocation changed to 40% for v3-beta." include keyboard shortcut 't' to toggle timeline compact/expanded and hint in tooltip.
eli.design: decision summary: CTA format "Increase to {percent}% — {variant}"; typed-confirm at >=50%; default expanded timeline (<=10), archived grouping beyond; add timeline search with autocomplete; include 'View audit' link in toast. i'll update figma and draft copy. ping for a quick 10-min review tomorrow.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary adjusted by zoe_pm — v3-beta to 40% (auto-rollback=false) — 2025-07-21T16:05:00Z
eli.design: thanks all — pushing updated mock and accessibility notes now. :rocket:
